title.zh: 流体垂直波数本征分支

summary: Solve a general complex fluid eigenmatrix and select positive-real least-damped kx branches.

capability: Solve a general complex fluid eigenmatrix and select positive-real least-damped kx branches.
operation: solve the fluid eigenmatrix for leading kx branches
complex square matrix and kn to full spectrum and filtered leading branches
discovery.boundary: selection rejects nonpropagating modes and returns at most keep branches

identity.relation: complex square matrix and kn to full spectrum and filtered leading branches
identity.direction: complex square matrix and kn to full spectrum and filtered leading branches
identity.definition: Solve kx X=M X with general complex LAPACK zgeev; keep Re(kx)>real_floor_scale*kn and stable-sort by |Im(kx)|.
identity.boundary: selection rejects nonpropagating modes and returns at most keep branches
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: matrix
inputs.description: Complex square matrix whose eigenproblem is solved, usually the fluid dispersion matrix
inputs.constraints: Nonempty square matrix with finite entries.

inputs.name: kn
inputs.description: Wavenumber normalization scale used to turn the real-part threshold into an absolute threshold

inputs.name: real_floor_scale
inputs.description: Relative real-part threshold for non-propagating eigenvalues

inputs.name: keep
inputs.description: Number of leading eigenvalues to return

outputs.name: eigenvalues
outputs.description: All eigenvalues, that is, the complete $k_\perp$ spectrum

outputs.name: selected
outputs.description: Eigenvalues whose real part exceeds the threshold, sorted in ascending $|\operatorname{Im}|$ order

outputs.name: head
outputs.shape: Complex array of length at most `keep`
outputs.constraints: When fewer than `keep` eigenvalues survive, returns every surviving value.

outputs.name: eigenvalue_count
outputs.description: Total number of eigenvalues, equal to the matrix order
outputs.constraints: Equal to the number of rows of `matrix`.

outputs.name: selected_count
outputs.description: Number of eigenvalues passing the real-part threshold

preconditions: selection rejects nonpropagating modes and returns at most keep branches
supported: Solve a general complex fluid eigenmatrix and select positive-real least-damped kx branches.
excluded: No mode identity or arbitrary-parameter accuracy is inferred beyond the declared numerical method.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for declared invalid inputs; numeric conversion errors may propagate for unsupported Python objects.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: The general complex LAPACK solver raises LinAlgError on nonconvergence.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative root solve is exposed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

example.description: Solve a diagonal complex eigenproblem and retain only the positive-real branch.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import solve_fluid_wavevector_eigenproblem
r=solve_fluid_wavevector_eigenproblem(matrix=__import__('numpy').diag([1+1j,-1+0j]),kn=1); assert len(r['selected'])==1
example.expected: Observed PASS: the diagonal witness exposes both eigenvalues and selects exactly the one branch with positive real part.
